text.p: Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd said on Monday its wholly-owned record company Mushroom Records has signed a nationwide distribution deal with Sony Music Entertainment Australia, a unit of Japan's Sony Corp.
Mushroom executive chairman Michael Gudinski said in a statement that the company has also appointed James Murdoch, Rupert Murdoch's youngest son, to its board.
"I see Mushroom as being a central part of News's expansion into music worldwide and I am very excited working with Michael and his strong team of people," James Murdoch said in the same statement.
Mushroom said in addition to the distribution deal Sony Music would make all Mushroom's product through its compact disc, cassette and printing facility in Western Sydney.

It said the distribution deal included other labels under the Mushroom umbrella, imprints White, Melodian, Liberation, Infectious and Bark. It did not include Mushroom's independent distribution arm MDS.
